gumtree_entries.description:
ADDED i1: Tests {@link Base16#isInAlphabet(byte)} for both the lower-case and upper-case Base16 alphabets.

The Base16 alphabet consists of the digits {@code '0'..'9'}
ADDED i2: Asserts that every character in the inclusive range {@code [first, last]} produces {@code expected} when passed to {@link Base16#isInAlphabet(byte)}.
ADDED i3: Asserts that a single character produces {@code expected} when passed to {@link Base16#isInAlphabet(byte)}.
ADDED i6: Characters just outside each accepted range are rejected.
ADDED i8: Characters just outside each accepted range are rejected.
